response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior generalist software engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and tooling skills, but the profile is a poor match for this embedded networking security role. There is no Japanese language ability listed (native-level Japanese is a hard requirement), no LAN-switch, Layer-2/Layer-3 networking, MACsec/802.1X, or switch-chip SDK experience, and no evidence of Linux kernel source analysis or modification. C/C++ experience exists but is limited and dated (National Instruments, 2014-2015, and a university-era C++ audio project), with the last decade focused on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and cloud/web platforms. Even setting aside the language barrier, the domain gap in embedded firmware and network security would require substantial retraining.
strengths: Long track record (15+ yrs) of shipping software across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded/hardware contexts
Prior C/C++ work at National Instruments on a C IDE, plus Linux and low-latency systems experience
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, dev-ops, open-source maintainership, and teaching/mentoring
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency indicated — fails a stated native-level requirement
No LAN-switch, L2/L3 networking, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF, or switch-chip SDK experience
No Linux kernel source analysis/modification experience; C work is minimal and roughly a decade old

key_factors.factor: Weak/dated C and Linux kernel background
